description: This file contains Go source code implementing a parser for navigation paths within Kubernetes configuration objects, utilizing reflection to traverse nested structures and maps.

classes.name: navigationSteps
classes.description: Represents a sequence of navigation steps through a configuration object.

classes.name: navigationStep
classes.description: Represents a single step in navigating a configuration object, including its value and type.

methods.name: newNavigationSteps
methods.description: Constructs a navigationSteps object by parsing a dot-separated path string into a sequence of steps.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Returns the current navigation step and advances the current step index.

methods.name: moreStepsRemaining
methods.description: Checks if there are remaining steps to navigate.

methods.name: findNameStep
methods.description: Determines the next name component in a path based on valid type options.

methods.name: getPotentialTypeValues
methods.description: Retrieves a map of JSON tags to field types for a given struct type.

methods.name: findKnownValue
methods.description: Finds the index of a known value within a list of path parts.
